name: aitrends-thumbnail
description: Turn a video script into YouTube thumbnail options for the What If channel: reads the script, finds the rule and the winning moment, composes each option freely for that script (smug channel hero, the rule as one game-UI layer, roster characters reacting, bright background, at most 3 words), draws them as flat 2D SVG, renders 1280×720 JPGs with a contact sheet and a rule check.
